pages.name: Two ways color mixes, and you ship into both

elements.text: Two ways color mixes — and you ship into both
Start at black. Adding light moves toward white.
Start at white. Adding ink moves toward black.
each additive primary is a secondary in the other
system, and the other way round.
A screen color need not be reachable in ink.

Three dials — schemes turn only one of them
how much of the hue is left in the color

The scheme names come from Johannes Itten’s 1961 Art of Color,
taught at the Bauhaus. Munsell drew a different wheel — so which
colors count as “complementary” depends on which wheel you
device, not a law of light.
